name: Internet Health Pro
release_gate: one shared monitoring engine per plugin process
native ICMP latency with honest TCP-connect, DNS lookup and HTTPS response timing labels
multi-signal outage detection with two-cycle confirmation
ICMP-blocked network fallback without false 100% probe loss
user-adjustable latency, jitter and probe-loss thresholds
manual-only throughput test capped at approximately 10 MB per run
clean Windows and macOS live network smoke
official Elgato Stream Deck CLI validation
deterministic Rat Art and marketplace kit preflight
final_boundary: Install the exact packaged .streamDeckPlugin in Stream Deck and physically observe live key rendering through a disconnect/reconnect and one manual speed test before Marketplace submission.
qa_note: Final ship-readiness gate passed on source/listing candidate 81b3fd24f53aafaabda0211c856913a3058cd454. The audit fixed explicit ICMP family command construction (macOS IPv4 uses plain ping; macOS IPv6 uses ping6; Linux IPv6 uses -6), reduced first-release notes to six scan-friendly bullets, and added regression checks for version consistency and extensionless Elgato manifest asset paths. Windows and macOS tests/build/live smoke, npm audit/check, official Elgato validation/package, deterministic Rat Art, package/media verification, Lite Pro Portfolio Audit, and Rat Ship Marketplace Routing CI all passed.

profiles.reason: Internet Health Pro is a standalone utility and does not promise a bundled dashboard profile. PackRat bundles profiles when layout is part of the product promise, such as Voice Deck and Valorant Tracker.

upsell.note: Do not invent a Lite counterpart. net-spike remains explicitly classified as a standalone free XENEON network probe, not an Internet Health Lite edition.
